Applications

Industrial application

🧱 Cooling for Injection MoldingCool mold and hydraulic oil together to hold cycle time and yield steady. 🍾 Cooling for Blow MoldingDual circuits for the die head and hydraulics: even wall thickness and shorter cycles. 🧵 Cooling for ExtrusionStable barrel and screw temperature: tight tolerances with no drift over 24-hour runs. 🛞 Cooling for Rubber ExtrusionStaged cooling on screw and product: lower scorch risk and stable profile size. 🔦 Cooling for Laser ProcessingStable temperature at source and optics: no power drop and consistent cut quality.
